Package.Name: Waze
Package.Author: Elie Bertret
Package.Description: Get paths and travel times from Waze's unofficial live-map routing service

Setting.name: Trips
Setting.description: Named trips - query with GetTripTraffic(tripName) instead of passing coordinates every time

Setting.name: Places
Setting.description: Named GPS points (Home, Work, Daycare, School...) - query any pair with GetPlaceTraffic(fromPlace, toPlace) instead of pre-defining every route combination as a Trip
